Field.Label: Connects Indigo to Roomie Remote via its Local Network Control API. Requires Roomie Remote X 10.3 or later with "Local Network Control" enabled in Roomie's settings on the Primary Controller. The controller device must stay running with Roomie in the foreground (a dedicated always-on controller or an iPad in Guided Access / Single App Mode is recommended). A static IP or DHCP reservation for the controller is strongly recommended.

Field.tooltip: When enabled, a relay-style Indigo device is created automatically for each visible activity the first time it is seen (on = activity running; turn on/off to start the activity or power off the room). Devices you delete are not re-created. Expect one device per activity in every room.
